title: Scripts start before the course map is done
detect_signals: A task is planned to start before the work it depends on ends
The link is there, but the window ignores it
sim_effect: The window promises progress the link forbids: the task can't start on time, so the weeks it was given are lost.
accepted_fixes: Start the task when the work it depends on ends
Sequence it after its input, or split it so only approved modules start early
partial_fixes: Keep the overlap but add a check-in
Ask the owner to start on what they can
concept: Sequencing: a window that ignores its own dependency is a hidden delay
sop_ref: LD SOP: course map approved before development; PM SOP: Design phase
explanation: Planning work to start before its input is ready makes the schedule look shorter than it is. When the input arrives late, the downstream work is squeezed or redone.
